external_games.name: ZWERG: A Tale of Beer and Hunger

name: Zwerg: A Tale of Beer and Hunger
summary:
This is a classic dungeon crawler chronicling the misadventures of a band of mysterious, bearded dwarves in search of rare "elixirs" within gloomy dungeons.

They will have to explore winding labyrinths, solve puzzles, disarm traps, battle monsters, suffer from hunger, and—of course—sample magical brews! Then again, these concoctions might just be the most dangerous thing in the dungeon; after all, a fight with a demon from another dimension is nothing compared to booze poisoning.
